programs.name: Computer Science (BSc, Faculty of Science: Physical, Earth, Math & Computer Sciences group)
programs.a_level_offer: Predicted/final A-Levels A*AA to ABB (typical minimum range; Physical, Earth, Math and Computer Sciences group)
programs.ib_offer: 35 to 38 subject points out of 42 (typical minimum range); each math and science subject 5 to 6, at least one 6; 6 if SL Math AA
programs.ap_offer: US high school diploma route (AP is not an entry requirement; AP results can earn advanced standing credit): grades 10-12 considered; B+ to A- unweighted average in each of grades 11 and 12, A- in each prerequisite math and science course; typical ACT 29-31 or SAT EBRW 690-700 / Math 690-710. ACT/SAT is optional for Fall 2027 applicants.
programs.required_subjects: A-Levels: three A-Levels in three different subjects, including A-Level Maths and at least one of biology, chemistry or physics (plus GCSE-level biology, chemistry, maths, physics). IB: Mathematics and two of Biology, Chemistry or Physics at HL or SL, at least one math/science at HL (SL Math AI not accepted). US: pre-calculus and two of biology, chemistry or physics.
programs.toefl_note: Faculty of Science minimum. Old 0-120 scale (tests up to 20 Jan 2026): 90 overall, 21 in each of Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking. New 1-6 scale (tests from 21 Jan 2026): 4.5 overall, 4.5 in Reading, Listening and Writing, 4.0 in Speaking.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component; Duolingo 125; PTE Academic 65 (60 per component). Not required if you attended school for 4 consecutive years in a country where English is the acknowledged primary language, or meet another listed exemption.
programs.notes: Admission is to the Faculty of Science (Physical, Earth, Math & Computer Sciences group) and CS is then declared as a major. The admissions pages list 'typical minimum admission grades' as guidelines only; they are not guaranteed offers, and McGill says the minimum varies from year to year. Fall 2027 entry: application deadline January 15, supporting documents March 1 (pages checked 2026-10-27). Fee: tuition line of the McGill 2026-27 international undergraduate table for the Bachelor of Science (CAD 64,785.90, rounded to 64,786); 2027-28 rates were not published, the table does not state the credit load, and it says tuition is guaranteed for the program length for students admitted in 2026-27. A-Level and IB ranges: https://www.mcgill.ca/undergraduate-admissions/apply/requirements/international/advanced-levels and https://www.mcgill.ca/undergraduate-admissions/apply/requirements/international/ib . AP / US route: https://www.mcgill.ca/undergraduate-admissions/apply/requirements/us (the US range there is shared by the Biological, Bio-Physical-Computational and Physical, Earth, Math and Computer Sciences groups). Fees: https://www.mcgill.ca/student-accounts/files/student-accounts/new_intl_ugrad_degree_students_admitted_2026-27_0.pdf . English: https://www.mcgill.ca/undergraduate-admissions/apply/english-proficiency . Course length is not stated on these pages, so none is shown.

programs.name: Economics (BA, Faculty of Arts)
programs.a_level_offer: Predicted/final A-Levels AAA to ABB (typical minimum range; Faculty of Arts)
programs.ib_offer: 33 to 36 subject points out of 42 (typical minimum range; Faculty of Arts)
programs.ap_offer: US high school diploma route (AP is not an entry requirement; AP results can earn advanced standing credit): grades 10-12 considered; B+ unweighted average in each of grades 11 and 12, B+ in English; typical ACT 27-29 (English and Reading subscores 26 or higher) or SAT EBRW 670-700 / Math 610-640. ACT/SAT is optional for Fall 2027 applicants.
programs.required_subjects: A-Levels: three A-Levels in three different subjects, no specific prerequisites. IB: no specific prerequisites. US: English.
programs.toefl_note: Faculty of Arts minimum. Old 0-120 scale (tests up to 20 Jan 2026): 90 overall, 21 in each of Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking. New 1-6 scale (tests from 21 Jan 2026): 4.5 overall, 4.5 in Reading, Listening and Writing, 4.0 in Speaking.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component; Duolingo 125; PTE Academic 65 (60 per component). Not required if you attended school for 4 consecutive years in a country where English is the acknowledged primary language, or meet another listed exemption.
programs.notes: Admission is to the Faculty of Arts; Economics is chosen as a major or honours program after entry (the Economics page says to apply to the Faculty of Arts). No economics-specific entry grade or maths prerequisite is published; the Arts ranges apply to every Arts program. The admissions pages list 'typical minimum admission grades' as guidelines only, not guaranteed offers. Fall 2027 entry: application deadline January 15, supporting documents March 1 (pages checked 2026-10-27). Fee: tuition line of the McGill 2026-27 international undergraduate table for the Bachelor of Arts (CAD 54,000.00); 2027-28 rates were not published, the table does not state the credit load, and it says tuition is guaranteed for the program length for students admitted in 2026-27. A-Level and IB ranges: https://www.mcgill.ca/undergraduate-admissions/apply/requirements/international/advanced-levels and https://www.mcgill.ca/undergraduate-admissions/apply/requirements/international/ib . AP / US route: https://www.mcgill.ca/undergraduate-admissions/apply/requirements/us . Fees: https://www.mcgill.ca/student-accounts/files/student-accounts/new_intl_ugrad_degree_students_admitted_2026-27_0.pdf . English: https://www.mcgill.ca/undergraduate-admissions/apply/english-proficiency . Course length is not stated on these pages, so none is shown.
